attribution: Substantive site and content updates. Routine dependency bumps are omitted.

entries.title: Depth pass: stories, eras, drafts, transactions, search
items: Added flagship longread route with Article JSON-LD and `/stories` index.
Expanded era hubs (expansion, Garnett, post-KG, Butler, Finch-modern) with cross-links to essays.
Season pages can show curated draft picks and transaction notes when JSON exists for that year.
Player profiles: Wolves highlight bullets (computed or JSON override), related reading, resilient headshots.
New `/figures` capsules, `/changelog`, `/search`, and data freshness note in the shell.
